goal: Prevent rolling Bloom filters from prematurely expiring unrelated entries when duplicate items are inserted
Preserve configured capacity guarantees when items are announced repeatedly
agreement: Asked whether this targets worrying real-world usage patterns or general correctness (instagibbs)
Author demonstrated that repeated announcements can trivially wipe the known-transaction filter

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because repeated insertions prematurely rotate the filter and expire unrelated entries before capacity
Fixes an edge case where duplicate entries degrade filter retention guarantees
